mods.name: Every Tunnel
mods.description: A singleplayer psychological horror experience set in the abandoned Noname Complex. You are the new night-shift security guard. Music: "Local Forecast - Elevator" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0). See CREDITS.md.

releases.notes:
## Every Tunnel 0.3.2 – demo of Levels 1 to 3, for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric).

One jar with the map, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin and GeckoLib inside. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, put the jar and [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights/versions?g=1.20.1) (4.4.0 or newer for 1.20.1) in mods/, press NEW GAME. See INSTALL.md.

### What's new

- **Your shift is saved.** Leave whenever you like: **CONTINUE** in the main menu takes you back to the start of the furthest level you reached, with what you carried and everything you solved (valves, boxes, books, the keycard's doors). Supplies you picked up stay picked up.
- **NEW GAME** starts the shift over from the elevator. With a game saved it asks first.
- Reaching the end of the demo clears the save.

Updating from 0.3.x or 0.2.x: replace the old jar in mods/. The map updates itself on the next launch. Your first time in 0.3.2 starts a new game; from then on, it is saved.

releases.notes:
## Every Tunnel 0.3.1 – demo of Levels 1 to 3, for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric).

One jar with the map, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin and GeckoLib inside. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, put the jar and [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights/versions?g=1.20.1) (4.4.0 or newer for 1.20.1) in mods/, press BEGIN. See INSTALL.md.

### Fixes

- **Only one watcher in the library.** A fresh install of 0.3 put a second one there, so every box sent two of them running. Worlds that already have two are fixed on the next launch.
- **No cheats.** The debug commands are gone from the release, and the map world now has cheats turned off (also an installed one, when it updates). The spawn eggs are no longer in the creative tab.
- Level 3: the "Cafeteria" sign now reads "Kitchen".
- The bunker tunnel's collapse can no longer take parts of the tunnel with it when it resets.
- The library clock stops as soon as the last book is back.
- A box or book still in your inventory from an earlier game no longer turns up as an extra one.

Updating from 0.3 or 0.2.x: replace the old jar in mods/. The map updates itself on the next launch.

## Every Tunnel 0.3 – demo of Levels 1 to 3, for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric).

One jar with the map, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin and GeckoLib inside. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, put the jar and [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights/versions?g=1.20.1) (4.4.0 or newer for 1.20.1) in mods/, press BEGIN. See INSTALL.md.

### What's new

- **Level 3: the offices.** Below the garage, the complex's offices round a vast central library: spotless, lit, and empty. Seventeen rooms, a long valve corridor, and a bunker under the library.
- **Something in the library watches.** It never hears you; it only has to see you. Keep low, keep your light off, stay out of its sight.
- **Hide in lockers.** Every room has one. Inside you make no sound and nothing sees you, as long as nothing saw you get in.
- **Puzzles:** set the valves to open the checkpoint, bring the archive boxes to Storage, and return the library's books to open the way down.
- **Company papers** left on desks and boards. Read them.
- **8 achievements**, with their own screen in the main menu (the credits moved to the GUIDE's last tab).
- **The guide** has new sections on hiding, carrying things, notes and water dispensers.
- A new ending: the demo now ends at the door to Level 4, at the end of the bunker tunnel.

Updating from 0.2.x: replace the old jar in mods/. The map updates itself on the next launch.

## Every Tunnel 0.2.1 – demo of Levels 1 and 2, for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric).

One jar with the map, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin and GeckoLib inside. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, put the jar and [LambDynamicLights](https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights/versions?g=1.20.1) (4.4.0 or newer for 1.20.1) in mods/, press BEGIN. See INSTALL.md.

### What's new

- **Fixed:** opening the world after finishing the demo no longer rolls the credits straight away.
- **Fixed:** the menu theme now starts again as soon as you are back in the main menu.
- **Fixed:** pressing Escape in Options no longer opens Minecraft's own title screen.

### LambDynamicLights and licence

- **LambDynamicLights is no longer inside the jar.** Its licence does not allow sharing it, so install it yourself. Without it, the game stops at start-up and asks for it.
- **Every Tunnel is now All Rights Reserved** (see LICENSE.txt). You may make and monetize videos and streams of it, and include it in modpacks that download it from CurseForge or GitHub. Please don't re-upload it.

Updating from 0.2.0: replace the old jar in mods/ and add LambDynamicLights. The map updates itself on the next launch.

## Every Tunnel 0.2.0 – demo of Levels 1 and 2, for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric).

One jar with everything inside: the map, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, GeckoLib and LambDynamicLights. Install Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, put the jar in mods/, press BEGIN. See INSTALL.md.

### What's new

- **A new main menu:** behind it, a parking hall of the Noname Complex, its lamps flickering now and then.
- **A new menu theme:** a slow, uneasy piano piece.
- **The way down to B3:** spiral stairs of steel grating in a deep, round metal shaft.
- **The Pale man** now follows you through low gaps, stooping under low ceilings; his chases no longer stop short.
- **Lights:** the garage's fluorescent lights are brighter, and the elevator is no longer dark when the game starts.

Updating from 0.1.0: replace the old jar in mods/. The map updates itself on the next launch.
